items.title: A leaky AI supply chain is exposing secret user data at an alarming rate
items.summary: Tests show AI supply chains frequently leak sensitive user prompt data, highlighting growing cybersecurity and privacy risks for businesses deploying third-party AI systems.

items.title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher’s fusion power startup. Here’s what they’re building.
items.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is investing in Europa Fusion, an AI researcher's energy startup working to develop commercial fusion power.

items.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis — and a human did, too
items.summary: Researchers have proposed an AI-assisted solution to the historic Riemann Hypothesis, demonstrating how machine learning is entering advanced theoretical mathematics.

items.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
items.summary: Donald Trump threatened steep taxes on companies building AI data centers abroad, adding potential regulatory and cost risks for firms scaling infrastructure.

items.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
items.summary: A new evaluation report shows AI continues exponential progress in coding tasks, though models still struggle with work requiring complex human judgment.

items.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
items.summary: An Anthropic mathematician claims to have used Claude to help solve the famous Riemann hypothesis, signaling major potential for AI-assisted scientific breakthroughs.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.summary: OpenAI introduced a multi-layered security strategy to stop third parties from extracting proprietary model capabilities through adversarial distillation.

items.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
items.summary: Hugging Face launched Inkling 2 Mini, a compact model built to provide high-performance AI capabilities directly on local hardware setups.

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Financial research firm Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra, reporting improved source coverage, better citations, and higher presentation quality for enterprise workflows.

items.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
items.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft expanded their computing partnership across Azure and Windows PCs, making it easier for businesses to build and deploy intelligent applications.

items.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.summary: Google previewed Tool Retrieval for the Gemini API, allowing developers to connect AI agents to hundreds of tools while reducing token consumption.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Neon, expanding its family of AI models for developers and enterprise builders.
